decision: EXP-001 is redesigned from empty-prompt unconditional joint generation to prefix-conditioned joint completion (card v0.3): each seed observes the first 3-6 words of a real COCO caption, ending just before the first object noun after the subject, and the 32 remaining caption positions and the 512-px image are generated jointly under the commit schedules. A construct gate PG-V (caption nouns found in the image by a pinned VLM, with a shuffled-partner baseline and a checker-validity precondition) runs on the J condition before any pilot sample is generated; a longer COCO prefix is the only fallback rung; failing both ends H-B and H-A2 as untestable on this checkpoint. A VLM-based consistency contrast (V-lift) is a required companion of the CLIP-lift primary through the reading condition R-c, and a text-front joint arm TFJ separates text-earlier from avoided co-commitment. Resolves red-team X1-F1 (empty-prompt captions may be web debris and CLIP lift could then measure watermark or style matching).

decision: EXP-001 ends at stage 0 as a feasibility result under its preregistered stop rule 11.1: PG-V failed at rung 1 (m - s = -0.016) and rung 2 (m - s = 0.151; required 0.25), with m - s_sp about 0 at both rungs and PC-F passing (checker valid: m_real 1.00, s_real 0.47). Under plain sampling at temperature 1 without guidance, UniDisc 1.4B at 512 px produces texture-like images and meandering web-caption tails, with no measurable text-image link beyond the shared prefix. H-B and H-A2 are untestable on this checkpoint in this regime; no D0 or later stage runs. Protocol deviation recorded: between the two rung-1 runs the engineer removed a space before the masked tail in the frozen prefix_rule.py (a tokenisation bug producing a lone '▁' token; manifest generations 2 and 3 hold both hashes; try 1 kept in _try1_lone_space_token/; both runs failed, so the deviation cannot have favoured a pass). Next: a new, separately preregistered EXP-003 on fresh pools measures the same consistency protocol under plain and under the official guided sampler at matched passes (does the value rule carry the joint consistency of a unified model?), which bears on the review's census finding.
